title: CO2 Assimilation in Plants from Genome to Biome Conference
level: Researchers (as stated on the conference page)
about: The 2027 Gordon Research Conference "CO2 Assimilation in Plants from Genome to Biome" takes place from 16 to 21 May 2027 at Renaissance Tuscany Il Ciocco in Lucca (Barga), Italy. Applications are submitted through the conference page on grc.org.
